label: ProductForge-Dashboard Backlog 136
title: Agents window UI: edit agent card (instructions + per-agent MODEL via model browser); stop agent -> re-run with updated model (whole pipeline)
body:
## Problem / why
The per-agent model is resolved DYNAMICALLY (agent card / tier) with no way to see or change it
from the UI. Operators cannot try a different model for one agent without editing backend config,
and cannot re-run just that agent afterwards. The dashboard Agents window must let a human edit an
agent card's model (and instructions), STOP the agent, then RE-RUN with the updated model.

## Goal & value
- See and control the model each agent actually runs.
- Browse/search ALL models by capability / behaviour / reasoning / modality / cost / context.
- Change one agent's model at runtime and re-run only what is affected (no full rebuild).

## In scope
- Agents window listing every agent/stage with its current RESOLVED model + source (override/tier/default).
- Per-agent model override (edit the agent card), PERSISTED.
- Model browser: free-text search + facets (capability, reasoning, modality in/out, behaviour, cost, context),
  with per-agent fit shown.
- Instruction overlay edit (append/replace; project + global).
- Stop agent -> apply change -> re-run agent + affected subtree (incremental/amend) with a change note.
- Show BEFORE vs AFTER (model + overlay) and which downstream agents will amend.

## Out of scope
- Editing the global model catalog / pricing (owner: BI-0173).
- Auto model-selection policy (owner: tier_builder, BI-0174).
- Per-request multi-model routing within a single agent.

## User flow (dashboard)
1. Agents window -> table: agent, stage, resolved model, model source, status.
2. Click agent -> drawer: instruction-overlay editor + current model + "Change model".
3. Change model -> model browser (search + facets) -> select -> preview fit vs agent needs -> Save override.
4. Stop the agent (per-agent control, BI-0046). Apply -> Re-run (incremental/amend) with a change note.
5. Show before/after (model + overlay) + downstream agents affected.

## Backend flow (consumed, by id)
- Agent+model SSOT (BI-0121): agent->model resolution.
- Model catalog (BI-0173): capabilities/modalities/reasoning/pricing/context for search + display.
- Model capability fit (BI-0077): validate the chosen model vs the agent's requirements.
- Per-agent control start/stop/pause/resume (BI-0046): stop + re-run.
- Incremental/amend mode (BI-0167): re-run the subtree without a rebuild.
- Overlays: core/prompt_overlays.py (existing store).

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
- Given an agent resolved to model M, when I set an override to M', then the window shows M' with
  source=override AND it persists across restart.
- Given a STOPPED agent with an override, when I re-run, then ONLY that agent + affected subtree run,
  and the downstream list is shown.
- Given the model browser, when I filter (modality=image / reasoning=true / max_cost), then only
  matching models appear, each showing context window + fit status.

## Data model (what is stored, where, owner)
- Per-agent MODEL OVERRIDE: NOT PRESENT today. Resolution is `core/orchestrator/model_router.py:get_agent_model_config` = stage.model > parent-stage > agent.model > default_model (from the tier config). A RUNTIME override needs a NEW persisted store + precedence `override > stage > agent > default`; single writer = the owning backend module.
- Instruction overlay: core/prompt_overlays.py store (existing).
- Re-run scope: derived from agent deps (no new store).

## API contract (endpoints + payloads)
- `GET  /api/agents` -> [{agent, stage, model, model_source, status}]
- `GET  /api/models?q=&capability=&reasoning=&modality=&max_cost=&min_context=`
  -> [{id, provider, context_window, modalities, reasoning, pricing, fit}]
- `GET  /api/agents/{agent}/model` -> {model, source}
- `PUT  /api/agents/{agent}/model` -> {model, source}   (persists the override)
- `POST /api/agents/{agent}/stop`
- `POST /api/agents/{agent}/rerun` {mode: amend|full, note}
- `GET  /api/agents/{agent}/rerun-plan` -> downstream agents affected

## UX (screens / elements / states)
- Table + drawer; facet chips; sticky search; model card with badges (reasoning, tools, modalities,
  cost/token, context window); before/after DIFF; explicit confirm for stop + re-run.

## Edge cases & errors
- Chosen model cannot fit the agent needs -> warn but ALLOW (explicit override).
- Agent is running -> must stop first; block editing while running.
- Override removed -> fall back to tier/default.
- Re-run with no changes -> no-op.
- Model not in catalog -> allow manual entry, flag as unverified.

## Dependencies & links
- paired_with: product_forge:BI-0167
- backend_capability: BI-0173 (catalog), BI-0077 (fit), BI-0046 (control), BI-0121 (SSOT)
- Absorbs former BI-0003 (Agent orchestration controls).

## Open questions
- CONFIRMED: no per-agent model override layer exists (model_router.get_agent_model_config reads tier config only). Q: add a small backend item for the override store + precedence (`override > stage > agent > default`)?
- Is "stop agent" per-AGENT or per-STAGE granularity?
- Should overrides be project-scoped or global?

## Verification / test plan
- API contract tests for each endpoint (incl. persistence of the override).
- E2E: change model -> stop -> re-run -> assert the artifact is re-generated and ONLY the subtree ran.
- Persistence test: override survives restart; removing it falls back to tier/default.
